newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks end firm, but off highs.
newsitem.headline: French stocks end firm, but off highs.

text.p: French shares recovered all of Tuesday's losses and made some headway, as the market welcomed the benign outlook for U.S. interest rates, traders said.
The CAC index regained the 2,800 level hit last week was unable to hold the gains amid profit-taking. Non-residents were said to be sellers.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 35.24 points or 1.28 percent at 2,786.35. The CAC-40 May futures contract was up 37 at 2,780 from Wednesday's close.
Volume was a heavy 10.15 billion francs, pushed up by block trades.
* Valeo closed up 0.63 percent at 366.8. The car parts maker said its sales rose some 13 percent in the first four months to 11.3 billion francs.

* Rhone-Poulenc Rorer firms 2.48 percent to 442.2. RPR's Taxotere drug has been shown more effective in treating metastic breast cancer than Pharmacia and Upjohn's Adriamycin, a paper to the American Society of Clinical Oncology showed.

* Lafarge closed down 0.63 percent at 394.7 francs. Company said the first quarter sales were encouraging and April's figures confirmed the trend. It has said it expects year sales of around 39 billion francs, up 10 percent from 1996.

* BNP firmed 2.41 percent to 263.80 francs. Massonaud held a meeting for fund managers on BNP, which was not represented. CSFB started coverage on the bank with a "hold" rating. Societe Generale was up 2.99 percent at 688.
* Total closed up 1.63 percent at 562, a new closing high, after drifting for two consecutive sessions. Elf was up 1.01 percent at 598.

* Sommer Allibert rose 1.08 percent to 224. Investment fund Verneuil Finance denied it and U.S. fund Wysrer-Pratt had acquired a declarable stake in the car parts company, which has been subject to takeover rumours.
* There has been market talk Sommer Allibert has been stalked by a predator, with General Motors' Delphi unit being among cited.
Verneuil managing director Franois Gontier said he did not confirm or deny any purchase of Sommer stock but that if any shares had been bought, no thresholds had been crossed requiring disclosure.
